newsitem.title: USA: Porta may still be delisted, extends offer.
newsitem.headline: Porta may still be delisted, extends offer.

text.p: Porta Systems Corp said Friday that if it does not satisfy all of the American Stock Exchange's financial guidelines for the continued listing of its common stock, its listing may not continue.

Porta also said that it has extended until December 31, 1996 its offer to exchange shares of common stock and zero coupon senior subordinated convertible notes due January 2, 1998 for its six percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2002.
A company spokesman said that Porta's nonsatisfaction of the AMEX financial guidelines is related to losses the company has reported.
The company said that 94 percent of the debentures have been tendered so far.
